findings.why: `either` presupposes exactly two rounds, but the same parenthetical names four (16, 17, 18, 21) for the three moved inputs and the witness-study tool moved in rounds 18 and 21, so the trailing clause has no consistent antecedent and names nothing an executor can check.

Neither command in the recipe (`.ufo/evidence/round-14/dispositions-before.json` in step 2, `.ufo/evidence/round-14/dispositions.json` in step 3) contains `expected.json`; the path appears only as the `expected_file` field of the tool's JSON output, so the commands below do not name it as the sentence asserts.
